sparse_reproduction: every stored argmax and B3 row of the three Ordered models is reproduced field by field

dense_system_gain.reading: Dense - Sparse B3 segment F1@50 consistent positive in both halves and Dense meeting every constraint -> 'an implementation gain of denser target requests with the same trained model'; never a new architecture or an order mechanism

goal_met.reading: only together with dense_system_gain and Dense's goal met -> 'the old development protocol goal is met'; the test split stays sealed

gain_without_constraints.reading: Dense - Sparse B3 segment F1@50 consistent positive in both halves while Dense misses a constraint -> 'a segmentation gain that does not meet the constraints'; not a system gain

offset_only.reading: Dense's mean absolute matched boundary offset (B3) below Sparse's in every seed and half, while no half has Dense - Sparse B3 segment F1@50 or native macro-F1 consistent positive -> 'finer localisation only; not evidence that the remaining loss comes from the grid'; this configuration ends without any stride, interpolation or decoding search

interpolation_close.reading: in a half where Dense - Interpolated B3 segment F1@50 is not consistent positive -> neither equivalence nor a gain wholly from new observations is claimed; Dense and Interpolated are reported by cost and counts and the primary condition is not changed

dense_costs.reading: Dense - Sparse with B3 consistent positive in native label switches per clip or same-class cut rate, or consistent negative in native macro-F1, in a half -> real gains and costs are both reported; Sparse stays the fixed reference; no threshold is retuned

native_localisation.reading: per half and condition, over the union of seeds by distinct recordings, each B3-wrong native clip falls in one stage by its own raw majority: decoding (the condition's argmax majority is right), sampling (it is wrong while the Dense argmax majority is right) or recognition (both are wrong); a recording wrong in several seeds counts in every stage it meets. More than half of the wrong recordings in decoding -> evidence for decoding research only; in recognition -> evidence for recognition research only; in sampling -> a sampling effect; otherwise mixed. Localisation only, never a trigger for training or a module; the report states which part sampling changes and which part stays unexplained

end.reading: the round ends at the report: no training, dense temporal head, ASRF or FACT retraining, distillation, expert pseudo-labels or external data; the paper stays paused; the patch-readout and FACT-refinement configurations stay closed

cases.note: figures stay on the server; each case is one condition, seed and source
